headline: Find the shop
intro: We're on Ridge Line Road — the county highway most map apps label wrong. Look for the green awning and the smell of roast.

directions.title: From the highway
directions.text: Exit at Mile Marker 14, north on Ridge Line 2.4 miles. We're on the left after the gravel pull-off — white building, pine-green awning.

directions.title: Parking
directions.text: Street spots out front. Small lot behind the building if the front is full — alley access between the hardware store and us.

directions.title: When GPS fails
directions.text: Call us. Seriously. Half our first-timers call from the gravel pull-off. We don't mind.
